prompt: Why would you create a branch instead of working directly on the main branch? What does forking a repository mean, and how is a fork different from a clone?
failureMessage: Your step 3 answer needs a bit more text. Please write 2–4 full sentences (with proper grammar and punctuation) in your own words covering: (1) why you would use a branch instead of working directly on main, and (2) what forking means and how a fork differs from a clone. Try explaining each idea as you would to a colleague who has not used Git before. If in doubt, re-reading the course materials can help.
